key_insight: Fast responses do not guarantee effective real-time interaction: leading models respond in under a second on average but achieve average window response rates no higher than 53.77%.
engineering_relevance: Real-time multimodal systems need evaluation of whether and when to respond, not just response speed and content quality.
method: Benchmark six tasks across proactive intervention, continuous engagement, and interaction coordination.
Use continuous audio/video streams to test visual engagement and overlapping or multi-party interaction.
Evaluate response quality, participation decisions, and response timing separately.
evidence_signal: DIVE includes 525 audio/video samples with fine-grained human annotations and precise temporal metadata; model performance varies substantially across tasks.
watch_item: Adapting ongoing responses to newly arriving information remains particularly challenging and warrants explicit testing before deployment.
paper_title: DIVE: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Interaction with Visual Engagement in Continuous Streams
